description: Innovative Green Infrastructure Project Has Diverse Funding And Financing Portfolio is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Office for Costal Management Digital Coast. Once a defunct golf course, Exploration Green is now a 200-acre urban green space providing the community with a solution for their stormwater flooding and recreational needs. Coverage: the United States (2022). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
